title: PREREQUISITE [2] - mechanical branch-freshness: consume 'require branches up to date before merge' as an unspoofable forge signal (certified merge-base===tip), closing QRM-3.2's stale-tightening residual; forgePolicySource becomes freshness-bound
acceptance: GitHubForge.resolveRefCommit(ref) resolves a ref to its tip commit sha via repos.getCommit(ref).data.sha, CERTIFIED full-lowercase-40-hex by construction (TreeParseError on malformed) - symmetric with resolveMergeBase so both sides of a freshness equality are certified; a 404 maps to absent (absence is never freshness). Added to the ForgeAdapter interface (LocalGitForge resolves via git rev-parse ^{commit}; MemoryForge via a refs fixture map). NOT built on the private resolveTreeSha, whose commitSha guard is typeof-string only, not 40-hex certified (design §3.1: asymmetric certification across an equality check is where an under-floor hides). resolveMergeBase, resolveTreeSha, compareStatus, CompareStatus, compare, listFiles are untouched; no shipped parse contract is widened

assertBranchFreshness(forge, protectedBranch, prHeadSha) proves merge_base(protectedBranch, prHeadSha) === tip(protectedBranch) from certified commit-graph object identity and throws to block, never returning a default. LOAD-BEARING order: (1) certify prHeadSha as the FIRST statement before any network call ([1] Fix-A pattern; sentinel zero-network-call tests via call counters); (2) resolveMergeBase FIRST; (3) resolveRefCommit SECOND; (4) inequality throws BranchFreshnessError carrying mergeBaseSha and protectedTipSha. A tip advancing between the two reads OVER-blocks (the safe direction under CHARTER §4), proven by a call-sequence recorder + a mid-sequence-advance regression test, not reasoned into

failure contract, three classes deliberately not collapsed (design §3.5): stale fork -> BranchFreshnessError (freshness); malformed prHeadSha -> input-layer certification error with ZERO network calls; malformed returned SHA on either side -> TreeParseError (forge, from the certified resolvers), garbage never compared; unresolvable branch/head (absent on either read) -> correct-by-layer block, NOT BranchFreshnessError. Catch-all inherited from [1] and reaffirmed: any throw blocks; no caller may assume a single error class

forgePolicySource is FRESHNESS-BOUND (design §3.3 / GPT amendment 2): it calls assertBranchFreshness internally and grades against the returned fork point, so it is structurally impossible to obtain a Gate-facing policy without a freshness attestation - closing the stale-fork / old-permissive-policy channel [1] deferred to [2]. Safe now because [1] shipped forgePolicySource with zero forge-mode callers. The [1] prHeadSha certification backstop is retained and the ~line-99 certifyCommitSha merge-base backstop is KEPT (a live [1] regression pin). A test proves forgePolicySource cannot yield a policy on a stale fork (the policy at the stale fork point is never read)

no @octokit/plugin-retry, plugin-throttling, or request hook is added: a per-read auto-retry could blur the load-bearing call order and, on an eventually-consistent replica, serve a stale-but-well-formed tip that spuriously equals the merge base (a false-fresh). The no-retry property holds by default; a comment at the Octokit construction site (forge/github.ts) records this so a future unrelated change cannot silently remove it. On transient failure: fail closed, or re-run assertBranchFreshness WHOLE - never retry one read in isolation

single-response equality (compare's base_commit + behind_by in one payload) CONSIDERED AND REJECTED (design §5): reaching it would widen the parsed response contract of a shipped, Codex-reviewed, trust-boundary function to save one read; two reads reuse already-red-teamed certification, add no field to any type, touch no [1] contract, and close the drift window in the safe direction via the call-order invariant. No base_commit or behind_by field is added to any type

does NOT wire the Gate ([0]), add a required status check, route the CLI to forge mode (stays --local), or claim [3] (trusted/pinned verifier). [2] proves freshness at VERIFICATION time only; the grade-to-merge race and the forge read-consistency residual are handed to [0] as hard, fail-closed wiring contracts (design §7), recorded not implemented here (principle 2: do not claim enforcement not shipped)
